verdict.rationale: The quickstart promises flags running in a few lines of code. Flags can be enabled or disabled per environment, including production, and the free tier includes unlimited flags without needing a data warehouse. A hands-on community report confirms a working flag in about 15 minutes with under 10 lines of code. Missing for 10: a documented step-by-step sign-up-to-toggle walkthrough in the UI, and explicit evidence that toggles reach production clients live without a redeploy (only implied via the proxy's 'real-time feature rollouts').
